review_description: Quote was more on the deceitful side. Overall install was good. Quoted on a 27 c payback where Red Energy only pays 10c

The crew from Northpoint Electric and Solar did an AMAZING job at our place installing a Sungrow inverter and 24-panel Powerwave system.The work done neat, professional and the panels look great and are operating fantastically!It is this kind of service that should be commended!! These guys were approachable, friendly and even went so far as to find a random broken tile on our roof, and found a neighbour with spare tiles and replaced it for us at no charge!  Thanks again Northpoint!Their price was very reasonable and I've recommended them to all my mates looking for solar - genuinely great Aussie service!John
Of the 3 quotes we received,only one salesperson physically came on site to quote. The others were done online using google maps etc. All were priced within a couple of hundred dollars of each other.
